headline: Why Your Drain Keeps Clogging: Common Mistakes to Avoid
articleBody:
It's super frustrating when your drain keeps backing up, isn't it? Sometimes, what seems like a simple clog can be a sign of a deeper issue, and certain habits can actually make it worse. We've all been there, trying to fix it ourselves, but some common mistakes can lead to recurring problems or even bigger plumbing headaches. Understanding these pitfalls can save you time, money, and a lot of mess in the long run.

### Common Mistakes to Avoid

When dealing with persistent drain issues, there are a few things you really want to steer clear of. First, repeatedly flushing a fully blocked toilet or running water into a completely clogged sink is a big no-no; it just increases the pressure and risk of overflow or backup. Another common mistake is pouring chemical drain cleaners down a fully blocked or suspected sewer line. These chemicals can be harsh, sometimes ineffective on tough clogs, and can even damage pipes or pose a safety hazard if they mix with other substances. Don't attempt to snake a main line without the right equipment; you could push the blockage further or damage your pipes. Finally, never enter contaminated standing water without proper protection – sewage contains harmful bacteria. If you have multiple fixtures backing up, or if sewage is present, that's a clear sign you need a professional to diagnose and fix the problem.
